name: @inneranimalmedia/theme-plain-jane
description: InnerAnimal Plain Jane (IAPJ) — a branded editorial blog, portfolio and publishing starter

scripts.build: npm --prefix source run lint && npm --prefix source run build -- --base /themes/plain-jane/demo/ --outDir ../site --emptyOutDir && node scripts/export-cms-manifest.mjs

store.name: InnerAnimal Plain Jane
store.summary: An installable, fully editable editorial theme with 31 authored page templates, category indexes, photography, articles and design tokens.

editorial.eyebrow: An editorial studio with room for ideas
editorial.headline: Publishing with clarity and character.
editorial.body: IAPJ brings a modern portfolio, deeply structured articles, category navigation, visual essays and a multi-mode design system into one cohesive blog starter.
notes: Editorial index, story collections and UX guide chapters
Dedicated work, photography, search and about pages
Light/dark design tokens and responsive navigation
Logical media references and first-party image assets

store.permissionNotice: Recipients may create, read, edit, duplicate, delete, privately develop and publish their independently installed theme copies. Source distribution remains maintained by InnerAnimalMedia Theme Store.
